hero.title: Translate, Preserve, and Connect
hero.subtitle: Translate and preserve endangered languages anywhere, even offline.

features.title: Designed for Remote Translation
features.subtitle: LangQuest makes translation possible even in the most challenging environments.

offline.title: Offline Tolerance
offline.description: Work without internet for extended periods. Your data is safely stored locally until you can sync.

ai.title: AI-Assisted Translation
ai.description: Use AI to generate initial translations, which users can review and vote on, speeding up the process.

gamification.title: Gamification
gamification.description: Features like leaderboards and rewards make translation fun and encourage participation.

openData.title: Open Data
openData.description: All validated translations become part of an openly licensed database, helping train future AI models.

howItWorks.title: How LangQuest Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Organize translations into projects, quests, and assets for efficient management.

projects.title: Create Projects
projects.description: Organize your translation work into projects, like translating the Bible or important cultural texts.

collaborate.title: Collaborate
collaborate.description: Invite community members to contribute translations and vote on each other's work.

validate.title: Validate & Share
validate.description: Validate translations through community voting and share them with the world.

useCases.title: Perfect For
useCases.subtitle: LangQuest is designed for a variety of translation needs.

future.title: Future: Peer-to-Peer Connectivity
future.subtitle: We're actively researching solutions to enable direct device-to-device sharing of translation data without internet.

features.share: Share updates between devices when team members meet
features.sync: Sync progress across multiple devices without internet
features.collaborate: Enable true collaboration in the most remote locations

cta.title: Join the LangQuest Community
cta.subtitle: Be among the first to use LangQuest and help preserve low-resource languages.
cta.notification: We'll notify you when LangQuest is ready for beta testing.

next.headline: Built around your voice.
next.description: Record, review, and organize oral Bible translations with your team. Keep working offline and sync when you reconnect.
next.note: The existing LangQuest app remains available below.

notifications.title: LangQuest Notifications
notifications.desktop_message: Please open the LangQuest app on your mobile device to view your notifications.
notifications.download_prompt: Download the LangQuest app to view your notifications and accept invitations:

meta.title: LangQuest: translate the Bible out loud
meta.description: Listen to the source. Speak the translation into a phone. Get each version heard early. It works for weeks with no signal.

hero.title: Translate the Bible <serif>out loud.</serif>
hero.lede: Listen to the source. Speak the translation into a phone. Get each version heard early. It works for weeks with no signal.
hero.available: On Android, iPhone and the web. No typing and no alphabet needed.
hero.photoAlt: Two people sit on the floor with tea, and one touches a phone that lies between them.

listen.title: Listen
listen.text: Play the source passage as many times as you need.
listen.alt: My Work shows the next passage.

speak.title: Speak
speak.text: Press the red button and speak. Each pause starts a new part.
speak.alt: The recorder listens and makes parts.

heard.title: Get it heard
heard.text: Publish a version, so that your team can listen while it is fresh.
heard.alt: The passage shows each check in order.

offline.title: No signal for a month? Keep working.
offline.text: Every change is saved on the phone first. When a connection comes, the work syncs. Nothing waits for the internet, and nothing is lost when it goes.
offline.savedText: Each recording stays on the phone until the server has it.
offline.syncText: Reach a connection, and the work goes up with no steps.
offline.joinText: Scan a code to join your team. No email is needed.
offline.badge: All your work is on this phone
offline.alt: The map of books shows progress.

process.title: A tool for the process your team already trusts.
process.text: Your organization sets its own checks, roles and reference material. LangQuest does not prescribe one method.
process.alt: The list of checks for a language.

teams.title: Each person sees the work that is theirs.

translators.title: Translators
translators.text: Open the app and see the next passage. Then speak.

reviewers.title: Reviewers
reviewers.text: Listen, say what to change, and approve. Every note stays on the record.

coordinators.title: Coordinators
coordinators.text: Invite people with a code, give roles, and follow each language.

proof.clipsText: audio clips recorded with LangQuest, as of 30 October 2026.
proof.quote: Translators in Mexico told us they needed “a box to put things in.”
proof.quoteText: So we rebuilt LangQuest from the ground up. Every passage, take, review and version is in one place, on the phone, even offline.
proof.note: Recordings you make stay with your organization, and your organization chooses who may use the work. LangQuest makes work and review visible. It does not certify a translation or replace the judgment of the community, translators and consultants.

end.title: Start with <serif>one passage.</serif>
end.text: Get the app for your phone, or log in with your LangQuest account.
